zh.title: 普惠加拿大修改發動機合約條款 IATA歡迎市場競爭改善
zh.summary: 普惠加拿大修改發動機二手零件合約；IATA表示歡迎並盼擴大市場競爭
body: 國際航空運輸協會（IATA）對普惠加拿大公司（P&WC）修改發動機二手零件市場的合約條款表示歡迎。此項合約修訂源於歐洲委員會競爭總署（European Commission Directorate-General for Competition）進行的審查與協調，旨在消除該市場中涉及競爭疑慮的相關限制。
本次合約變更放寬了普惠加拿大授權維修網路的限制，移除原先可能阻礙獨立供應商取得二手發動機零件及相關服務的條款。不過，該修訂範圍僅限於普惠 PT6 與 PW100 系列渦輪螺旋槳發動機的二手零件，並不涵蓋普惠旗下大型民航噴射發動機，亦未涉及主管機關批准的替代零件與維修方案。
IATA 營運、安全與安保高級副總裁 Nick Careen 指出，歐盟委員會的審查促使普惠加拿大進行改善，為渦輪螺旋槳發動機售後市場注入更多競爭與選擇。然而，公平取得、市場競爭與客戶選擇權等原則應適用於整個發動機售後市場。航空公司無論使用何種發動機，均應有權自由選擇經監管機構批准的維修設施、零件及維修服務，短期內將有助於緩解零件短缺與維修產能瓶頸。
當前供應鏈挑戰對全球航空公司造成顯著營運壓力。根據 IATA 與 Oliver Wyman 合作的調查研究估計，供應鏈限制在 2025 年使全球航空公司的發動機租賃與維修成本增加了約 57 億美元。推動市場競爭並增加零件與維修選擇，被視為減輕航空公司營運壓力與減少飛機停飛的重要措施之一。
歐盟委員會針對普惠加拿大的調查結果，進一步擴大了今年早些時候 IATA 與 CFM International 就發動機售後市場做法達成續約協議所帶來的效益。該協議透過允許獨立維修服務商參與競爭，並支援使用所有經主管機關批准的零件與維修方案，進一步促進了 CFM 商業發動機系列的維修選擇與市場競爭。

en.title: IATA Welcomes Pratt & Whitney Canada Engine Aftermarket Contract Changes
en.summary: IATA welcomed Pratt & Whitney Canada contractual changes to improve engine aftermarket competition.
body: The International Air Transport Association (IATA) has welcomed changes made by Pratt & Whitney Canada (P&WC) to contractual terms that had raised competition concerns in the market for used engine parts. The modifications follow work carried out by the European Commission Directorate-General for Competition.

The revised contractual terms remove restrictions on maintenance shops within P&WC's network that could have limited independent suppliers' access to used engine materials and associated services. However, these adjustments are limited strictly to used parts for P&WC's PT6 and PW100-series turboprop engines. They do not cover Pratt & Whitney's larger commercial jet engines or address the use of regulator-approved alternative parts and repairs.

Nick Careen, IATA’s Senior Vice President Operations, Safety and Security, stated that while the European Commission's work brought more competition and choice to part of the turboprop engine aftermarket, principles of fair access, competition, and customer choice should apply across the entire engine aftermarket. Careen emphasized that airlines should have the freedom to choose among all regulator-approved maintenance facilities, parts, and repairs, which could help alleviate supply shortages and maintenance constraints.

Supply chain constraints continue to exert heavy financial pressures on the global airline industry. According to a joint study by IATA and Oliver Wyman, supply chain disruptions added approximately $5.7 billion to airlines' engine leasing and maintenance costs in 2025. IATA noted that broader competition and additional options for parts and repairs are key measures to help ease these pressures.

The outcome of the European Commission's probe into P&WC adds to benefits gained earlier in 2026 through the renewal of IATA's agreement with CFM International regarding engine aftermarket practices. That agreement enhances competition across CFM's commercial engine portfolio by enabling independent maintenance providers to compete and supporting the use of all regulator-approved parts and repair options.

zh.title: 國防部偵獲16架次共機出海 11架次跨越海峽中線警巡
zh.summary: 國防部9日偵獲16架次共機出海，其中11架次逾越海峽中線，國軍派機艦與飛彈應處。
body: 中華民國國防部9日中午發布新聞稿表示，自當日上午9時22分起，陸續偵獲中共殲-10、蘇愷-30、殲轟-7、運-8遠干機及空警-500等各型主、輔戰機與無人機共16架次出海活動。
國防部指出，在偵獲的16架次軍機中，共有11架次逾越台灣海峽中線，進入台灣北部、中部及東部空域，並配合中共軍艦執行所謂「聯合戰備警巡」，騷擾台灣周邊空海域。
針對中共解放軍的軍事動態，國防部強調，國軍已運用聯合情監偵手段進行嚴密掌握，並檢派任務機、艦艇以及岸置飛彈系統進行適切應處。

en.title: Taiwan Detects 16 PLA Aircraft with 11 Crossing Median Line in Joint Patrol
en.summary: Taiwan detected 16 PLA aircraft on September 9, including 11 crossing the Strait median line.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense stated on September 9, 2026, that starting at 9:22 AM, 16 PLA aircraft sorties—including J-10, Su-30, and JH-7 fighters, Y-8 electronic warfare aircraft, KJ-500 airborne early warning aircraft, and drones—were detected operating off Taiwan.

According to the ministry, 11 of the 16 detected sorties crossed the median line of the Taiwan Strait, entering Taiwan's northern, central, and eastern airspace. The aircraft operated in coordination with PLA naval vessels executing a joint combat readiness patrol in the surrounding sea and airspace.

In response, Taiwan's armed forces monitored the military activities using joint intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance systems, and deployed task aircraft, naval vessels, and shore-based missile defense systems to respond appropriately.

zh.title: 蕭美琴倡無人機非紅供應鏈 強化防衛能力
zh.summary: 副總統蕭美琴強調無人機須採非紅供應鏈；濱海監偵等機型將由台灣國內製造。
body: 副總統蕭美琴於2026年9月9日出席「2026台北安全對話」致詞表示，無人機與反無人機技術已改變戰場型態。她指出，政府已向立法院提出用於無人機採購的特別預算案，其中濱海監偵型、濱海攻擊型與無人攻擊艇將由國內製造，且生產與採購（含民用）必須使用完全的非紅供應鏈，以降低風險與依賴。
此前，立法院已於2026年8月14日三讀通過115年度中央政府總預算案。其中，經濟部主導的「無人載具產業發展統籌型計畫」約新台幣80億元預算獲得全數通過，該計畫以推動台灣成為民主供應鏈中心為目標。

en.title: Hsiao Bi-khim Advocates for Non-Red Drone Supply Chain to Enhance Defense
en.summary: Vice President Hsiao Bi-khim advocates for non-Red drone supply chains to strengthen defense.
body: Speaking at the 2026 Taipei Security Dialogue on September 9, 2026, Vice President Hsiao Bi-khim emphasized that unmanned systems and counter-drone technologies have transformed the battlefield. She noted that the government has submitted a special budget proposal to the Legislative Yuan for drone procurement. Among the planned acquisitions, coastal surveillance drones, coastal strike drones, and unmanned strike boats will be manufactured domestically. Furthermore, all government drone production and procurement, including civilian purchases, must utilize a completely non-Red supply chain to mitigate risks and dependency.

This policy aligns with ongoing legislative support. On August 14, 2026, the Legislative Yuan passed the central government budget for fiscal year 2026, which fully approved approximately NT$8 billion for the Ministry of Economic Affairs' program to promote the development of the unmanned vehicle industry.

zh.title: 清泉崗機場遭無人機干擾 暫停起降影響10架次軍民機
zh.summary: 空軍清泉崗基地因周邊無人機活動暫停起降，影響10架次軍民機並移交調查
body: 清泉崗空軍基地於2026年9月8日晚間因無人機干擾而暫停飛機起降。空軍司令部表示，當晚7時37分在機場周邊發現無人機活動，危害飛航安全，隨即通報航警局及飛管單位進行應處，並暫停機場的所有起降作業。
經確證無人機已飛離管制區後，清泉崗基地於同日晚間8時2分恢復起降作業。在該起干擾事件期間，共影響了2架次的民航班機以及8架次的軍用飛機起降。空軍司令部強調，無人機在管制區活動屬於違法行為，危害飛航安全，目前已移請航警局調查。

en.title: Drone Interference at Ching Chuan Kang Suspends Flights, Affecting 10 Aircraft
en.summary: Ching Chuan Kang suspends operations due to a drone sighting, affecting 10 flights.
body: Ching Chuan Kang Air Force Base suspended aircraft takeoffs and landings on the evening of September 8, 2026, due to drone interference. The Air Force Command stated that drone activity was detected around the perimeter of the airport at 7:37 p.m., posing a threat to flight safety. The base immediately notified the Aviation Police Bureau and flight control units to respond, and suspended all flight operations.

After confirming that the drone had flown out of the restricted airspace, Ching Chuan Kang Base resumed takeoff and landing operations at 8:02 p.m. the same day. According to the Air Force, the temporary suspension affected two civil flights and eight military flights. The Air Force Command emphasized that operating drones within restricted areas is illegal and endangers aviation safety, adding that the case has been referred to the Aviation Police Bureau for investigation.

zh.title: 英國航管系統故障致逾千班機受阻 瑞安等航司強烈抗議
zh.summary: 英國航管系統發生技術故障；致逾千航班受阻；瑞安航空等航司要求改革
body: 2026年9月8日，英國國家航空交通服務公司（NATS）發生嚴重的技術故障，造成超過1000架次航班受阻。此次航管系統故障在英國全國多個主要機場引發了廣泛的航班延誤與取消，給當天的航空營運造成極大混亂，並引發了多家航空公司的強烈不滿。
NATS表示，系統故障主要影響了其航班處理系統。該機構於當地時間13點46分宣布開始調查該起事件，最初的技術故障限制了航班的起飛。雖然NATS隨後於下午約16點40分實施了系統修復，且系統也已逐步開始恢復，但由於飛機與機組人員的停放位置被打亂，後續的航班受阻情況依然在持續。
根據FlightAware與Flightradar24的監測資料，包括希斯洛、蓋威克、曼徹斯特、倫敦城市、盧頓、愛丁堡、布里斯托及斯坦斯特德在內的多個主要機場均通報出現混亂。統計顯示，當天至少有625架次往返英國機場的航班被取消，大批從英國出發或抵達英國的航班也遭到嚴重延誤。此外，由於歐洲其他地區的航空公司必須將飛往英國的航機留在地面，這起故障也波及了英國以外的歐洲各航點。
面對大規模的混亂，各航空公司表示極度憤怒。瑞安航空指出，其有超過6.5萬名乘客受到高達8小時延誤的影響，該航司更被迫取消了50多個航班。瑞安航空營運長Neal McMahon痛批，在2023年航管系統崩潰後，他們被承諾會吸取教訓並提升系統韌性，然而如今卻再次發生類似事件。瑞安航空已要求NATS執行長Martin Rolfe辭職，而匈牙利低成本航空Wizz Air亦公開宣告該航管機構已「不適任」。
英國航空在希斯洛機場也至少取消了16架次出發的航班。英國民用航空局對此表示，預期NATS將針對這起故障事件提交一份完整的調查報告。監管機構隨後將根據報告內容評估是否需要採取進一步的改善行動，以提升英國航空交通管制系統的可靠性。目前，造成這起9月8日系統故障的確切原因仍未對外公布。

en.title: UK Air Traffic Control Failure Disrupts Over 1,000 Flights Triggering Airline Outrage
en.summary: NATS system failure disrupted UK flights on September 8; over 1,000 flights delayed or canceled
body: On September 8, 2026, a major technical failure occurred at National Air Traffic Services (NATS), the United Kingdom's air traffic control provider, disrupting more than 1,000 flights. The system failure triggered widespread delays and cancellations at major airports across the country, causing massive disruption to the aviation industry and sparking strong reactions from several airlines.

NATS stated that the technical issue affected its flight-processing system. The organization announced at 13:46 local time that it had initiated an investigation into the matter, which initially restricted flight departures. Although NATS implemented a system fix at approximately 16:40 and systems began to recover, airlines warned that flights would continue to face disruptions because aircraft and crew members had been left out of position.

According to FlightAware and Flightradar24 data, major airports including Heathrow, Gatwick, Manchester, London City, Luton, Edinburgh, Bristol, and Stansted experienced disruptions. The monitoring data indicated that at least 625 flights to and from UK airports were canceled during the day. Additionally, the breakdown affected flights across Europe as several airlines held UK-bound aircraft on the ground to manage the situation.

Airlines expressed severe frustration over the widespread network failure. Ryanair reported that more than 65,000 of its passengers were affected by flight delays of up to eight hours, and the Irish low-cost carrier canceled over 50 flights. Ryanair Chief Operations Officer Neal McMahon stated that following a similar systemic collapse in 2023, the industry was assured that lessons would be learned and resilience improved. The airline called for NATS CEO Martin Rolfe to resign, while Hungarian low-cost carrier Wizz Air declared that the air traffic control organization was "not fit for purpose."

British Airways also canceled at least 16 departures from Heathrow. The UK Civil Aviation Authority announced that it expects NATS to deliver a comprehensive report explaining the incident. The regulator will subsequently evaluate whether further regulatory or corrective measures are necessary to improve the reliable performance of the nation's air traffic control infrastructure. The root cause of the September 8 system failure has not yet been disclosed.
